IS 11140 : 2024 Automotive Vehicles - Footrests for Two-Wheeled Motor Vehicles - Requirments
ICS 43.040
ICS 43.040
TED 06
TED 06
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the requirements for footrests or a floor or floor boards for L1 and L2 categories of vehicles as defined in IS 14272.
2 REFERENCE
The standard given below contains provisions, which, through reference in this text, constitutes provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of this standard.
